commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "cat AGENTS.md docs/index.md docs/completion.md docs/export-notes.md && git diff -- tasklist/cli.py tasklist/tasks.py tests/test_tasks.py && rg --files --hidden -g '"'!.git/**'"'"
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat README.md CLAUDE.md tasklist/tasks.py tasklist/cli.py tasklist/__init__.py tests/test_tasks.py'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import ast
import re
from pathlib import Path
pages = [Path('AGENTS.md'), Path('CLAUDE.md'), Path('README.md'), *Path('docs').glob('*.md')]
count = 0
for page in pages:
    for label, target in re.findall(r'\\[(["'^'"\\]]+)\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)', page.read_text()):
        dest = page.parent / target.split('#', 1)[0]
        assert dest.is_file(), (page, target)
        if label == 'finish_task' or label.startswith('test_'):
            symbols = {node.name for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(dest.read_text())) if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))}
            assert label in symbols, (page, label, target)
        if label == 'CLI main function':
            assert any(isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == 'main' for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(dest.read_text())))
        count += 1
print(f'Checked {count} local documentation links and referenced completion symbols.')
PY"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- docs/completion.md && git status --short'
